goal: Remove all version mentions from the website UI across HTML pages, metrics ribbons, download buttons, and dynamic client scripts

steps.title: Identify all occurrences of version text, badges, labels, and dynamic data-gh-version tags across HTML files and JavaScript controllers
Update index.html, dynamo.html, and agent-guard.html to remove explicit version numbers from buttons, metrics, and changelogs
Update js/github-releases.js and js/appstore.js to prevent client-side injection of version numbers into UI elements
Verify website pages and download functionality, commit to git, and push to GitHub repository webstore
